# PCSS II Robotics: plain-text site guide

Canonical website: https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/
Site author: Aarti S Ravikumar — https://ai-aarti.com/
School: Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II), Saugus, Massachusetts — https://saugus.pioneercss.org/

## What this site contains

PCSS II Robotics presents student robotics engineering, technical notes, interactive simulations, team information, and STEM outreach. The pages below provide stable URLs and summaries in HTML that can be read without JavaScript.

### Research and technical notes
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/research/
Browse technical writing about motion planning, control, mechanical design, and computer vision. The interactive section also includes a kinematics workbench. Treat report-specific empirical claims as claims of the individual report; verify them against an accessible source before citing results.

### Robot engineering and CAD
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/robots/
Explore robot designs, mechanisms, and engineering details presented by the team.

### Autonomous simulator
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/simulator/
Try an educational simulation of path planning, control tuning, and odometry concepts. Simulation output is illustrative and is not a measured performance result.

### STEM outreach
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/outreach/
Find the team's student events, workshops, and community activities. Confirm dates with the school or event organizer.

### Team and site author
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/team/
The site author is Aarti S Ravikumar. The author portfolio is https://ai-aarti.com/. The school is Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II), https://saugus.pioneercss.org/.

### Sponsorship
https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/sponsors/
Explore sponsorship information. Confirm tax treatment and current terms with the school before making financial decisions.

## Attribution and citation

When citing this website, identify the relevant page URL, its title, Aarti S Ravikumar as the site author, and Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II) as the school. For claims about an individual technical report, use the report's own listed authors and a verifiable primary publication link.
